description: A clinic administrator must finalize next week's one open after-hours infusion slot for a patient, with input from an infusion nurse and a care coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The clinic has one open after-hours infusion slot next week.
shared_context.S2: Two patients are being considered for that slot: Patient Green and Patient Patel.
shared_context.S3: Elena makes the final assignment and records any follow-up arrangements tied to the choice.
shared_context.S4: Patient Green and Patient Patel have both been using daytime appointments so far.
shared_context.S5: Before finalizing the schedule, Elena consults the infusion nurse and the care coordinator.

PF1.text: Patient Green's infusion requires a pharmacist verification step that is only staffed during regular daytime hours, so Green cannot be safely scheduled in the after-hours slot.

PF2.text: Patient Patel's employer has approved paid medical leave for only one more daytime visit this month, but Patel has already used that final daytime leave day on another specialist appointment, so an after-hours slot is needed to avoid another missed workday.

acceptance_conditions: The after-hours slot must be assigned to Patient Patel.
Patient Green's follow-up arrangement must be recorded specifically as a daytime slot.
A follow-up scheduling commitment for Patient Green must be recorded.
The daytime follow-up for Patient Green must be set within 14 days.
The plan must record zero planned work-absence days for Patient Patel.
Patient Green's after-hours restriction must be explicitly credited and cited after it is said aloud.
Patient Patel's work-leave limit must be explicitly credited and cited after it is said aloud.

content_checks.C3: any(c['type'] == 'schedule_followup' and (c['target'] == 'Patient Green' or c['target'] == 'Green') for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: PF1 changes Green's follow-up from an unspecified reschedule to a specifically daytime follow-up with a recorded scheduling commitment inside the 14-day window.
PF2 changes Patel from a routine candidate to the patient who must receive the after-hours slot so the plan records zero planned work-absence days.
